notes:
- Every PvP kit has its icon now, a mace for Mace and a bow for Bow, on the Ranks page, in the leaderboards and in name tags.
- Friends: add anyone by their Minecraft name, see who is online and on which server or world, and get a pop-up when a friend comes online.
- Profiles: pick your favourite title from any rank you hold, the kits you play and a short bio. Everyone can open anyone's profile, with all their ranks.
- The Right Shift menu has categories down the left: Settings, Waypoints, Leaderboard, Friends, Players and your Profile.
- Waypoints in the Right Shift menu: set one where you stand, per dimension. They stay after quitting and only show in the world or on the server they were made in.
- A leaderboard in game with a global board and a local one for the Iris Client players on your server.
- Friends see which server you are on only while Share my server is on in Right Shift, Settings.

Suggested by Ghostlex
